server.name: community-contentrain
server.note: All 22 tools declare readOnlyHint and all 15 mutating ones declare idempotentHint, so every fixture here has a declaration to exercise. Writes are auto-committed to git, so the effect is read from commit subjects and trees rather than hashes. The fixture repository is the trial root itself: this server works on its working directory, so pointing it at a subdirectory while the process runs elsewhere does not keep its state inside the mount.

observer.note: context.json and the meta files are ignored: both carry a wall clock timestamp (meta records updated_at), so a clean baseline never reproduces them. The content file is keyed by entry id, so if a repeat overwrites that key the end state cannot distinguish one application from two. The fixture is therefore read as indistinguishable rather than as deduplicated.

server.note_container: the package is @contentrain/mcp but its binary is contentrain-mcp, so the last-segment convention gives `mcp` and the container exits at once

fixtures.note: declared idempotentHint:true, takes a list of entries, and auto-commits, so F5 applies as well as the repeat modes
